question: Should generic tool-progress intent become a supported public Plugin SDK reply-payload contract, or remain internal to bundled producer and channel paths?
rationale: The Slack correctness repair is mechanical, but adding a permanent third-party constant and predicate is a compatibility and ownership decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Keep Intent Internal
options.body: Use a narrower internal or bundled seam for Codex-to-Slack progress typing and avoid expanding the third-party API.

options.title: Approve Public Contract
options.body: Keep the exports, document their semantics and stability, and add focused public contract coverage for plugin producers and channel consumers.

recommendation.title: Keep Intent Internal
recommendation.body: Use a narrower internal or bundled seam for Codex-to-Slack progress typing and avoid expanding the third-party API.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work shows the strongest ownership across both Slack native-block delivery and Plugin SDK surface decisions.
